text:
alex: Quick sync — proposing a short heuristic doc for routing decisions + launch gating for the tenant isolation pilot. Want alignment before Q3 planning. TL;DR: decision matrix, customer ask handling, and minimal gating metrics.

priya: SGTM. Can you paste the proposed heuristic? want to check overlap with Dedicated capacity rules.

alex: sure — rough sketch below, meant to be minimal and operationally actionable:
```
heuristics:
  prefer: same-region if p95 latency < 120ms
  fallback: nearest-region-candidate sorted by (cost_weight * cost + latency_weight * p95_ms)
  heavy_customers: 
    threshold_qps: 500
    requirement: dedicated_slice or capacity_commit
  isolation_tiers: [isolation, soft-shared, shared]
launch_criteria:
  - canary: 24h stability with <=1% error delta vs baseline
  - latency: p95 <= baseline_p95 + 10ms
  - quality: eval-set pass rate >= 98% (no regression alerts)
  - cost: unit_cost <= 1.2 * baseline_unit_cost
```

jamie: I like it. Couple asks: (1) add synthetic load test thresholds (ramp to 2x expected qps), (2) define the telemetry queries we need for canary alerts, (3) include rollback triggers (eg: sustained +5% error for 10m).

maria: also need a clear mapping for EU data residency customers — if tenant requires EU-only, fallback should be blocked and we must route to a customer-dedicated EU slice.

sam: heads-up on egress & cross-region bandwidth — fallback to nearest region might explode network costs for multi-tenant customers. Suggest adding a model-variant fallback: quantized / small-variant with similar quality SLACKED for latency/cost tradeoffs.

priya: good point. For Dedicated customers we should prefer capacity commit over cross-region fallbacks. We'll add an explicit precedence list in the decision matrix.

alex: adding jamie's load test and rollback bullets. For owners: priya -> runbook + precedence matrix; jamie -> canary telemetry + rollback queries; maria -> EU residency mapping doc; sam -> cost/egress sim and model-variant fallback options. I'll coordinate scheduling.

eng-bot: deploy-bot created canary cluster "isolation-pilot-canary-01" in us-west-2 — status: provisioning.

priya: I'll start a draft runbook in the docs repo and link it here when ready.

jamie: I'll post the Grafana/KQL queries by EOD tomorrow and wire up a synthetic runner for the 2x ramp test.

maria: drafting the EU mapping table now, will ping legal for residency confirmation.

sam: running a quick cost delta sim now — will post numbers (best/worst) and a lightweight proposal to prefer quantized fallback when cross-region egress > $X/hr.

alex: thanks all. Next step: 30m sync Friday 10:30 PT to finalize gating and owners. If anyone can't make it, pls add notes to the runbook PR.

priya: :thumbsup:

jamie: noted.

maria: thanks.

sam: will be there.

alex: closing the loop — I'll update the product roadmap ticket with this heuristic summary and link PRs.
